name: The Odds API
tagline: Sports betting odds from many bookmakers with a free monthly developer quota
description: The Odds API aggregates real-time and historical sports betting odds from dozens of bookmakers worldwide. It covers major sports and leagues with endpoints for events, odds, scores, and participant data. Developers authenticate with a self-serve API key and start on a free monthly request quota, with paid tiers for higher volume and historical data access.

auth.details: API key via apiKey query parameter (self-serve signup); key also accepted in some client examples. No OAuth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 500 credits/month free (odds endpoints may cost multiple credits per region; GET /sports is free)
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans scale by monthly request volume; see official pricing

use_cases: list active sports and leagues available for odds
get current betting odds for a sport across bookmakers
fetch live scores for upcoming or in-play events
compare bookmaker odds for arbitrage or value spotting
pull historical odds snapshots for backtesting models
